analysis:
This PR changes only documentation: a new changelog entry (changelog.d/streamed-auto-tool-calls.md) and a docs/architecture/inference.md update. No executable code is in the supplied units, so I found no concrete security regression. The docs describe three behavior changes in code that is not supplied: (1) streaming of tool_choice=auto tool-call fragments (streamToolCallDeltas, ToolCallProcessor streaming, NativeToolStreamRouter); (2) a content-seed for Qwen3-VL when the prompt tail has no think marker; (3) a linear-time parser for long tool calls. The response hash also gains one tool_call marker per fragment.

Things the next pass should check against the real code:
- A tool call is now exposed before its schema validation completes. The docs say a typed tool_choice violation is raised afterward if the parse fails, diverges or violates the schema. Verify that no exposed fragment can hold undeclared names, since a name is only exposed once it resolves to a declared tool. Check that the stream error path cannot leak a partial call that fails validation, that parallel_tool_calls cardinality is enforced at the first fragment, and that required/named choices still validate before output.
- Qwen3-VL content seeding could expose reasoning text as answer content for close-only reasoners. The docs limit the seed to qwen3_vl_moe. Confirm that restriction in ReasoningPromptProbe.plainTailContentModelTypes.
- The response-hash change in ProviderLoop+SSEParser.swift encodeToolCallsForHash should be checked for consistency with the coordinator's verification. This is a platform-owned contract and is not visible here.
- The streamed encrypted fragments pass through the existing hop-by-hop encryption (T-008). Confirm that fail-closed behavior on encryption failure is preserved per fragment.
- The DoS fix for quadratic parsing relates to T-010 and T-029, and is positive.

These all depend on unseen source, so I set needs_deeper_review true only for those unverified code contracts. I make no claim about the code behaving as documented.
